(Japanese: '''カビゴンの夢グルメ''' ''{{tt|Kabigon|Snorlax}}'s Dream Gourmet'') is a six-chapter [[Pokémon manga|Pokémon web manga]] created by [[Taku Kuwabara]] as part of [[Project Snorlax]], being released each Friday at 09:00 UTC.<ref>https://www.pokemon.jp/special/project_kabigon/20240119/</ref>. It was announced in June 2023, originally scheduled for a release in Fall 2023,<ref>https://web.archive.org/web/20240119140752/https://www.pokemon.jp/special/project_kabigon/video/03.html,</ref> quietly being delayed until the first chapter released simultaneously on January 19, 2024 on Twitter<ref>[https://twitter.com/project_kabigon/status/1748269071148220728 Chapter 1 on Twitter]</ref> and Instagram.<ref>[https://www.instagram.com/project_kabigon/p/C2RqnIFsJfR/ Chapter 1 on Instagram]</ref> The final chapter released on February 23rd, 2024.<ref name=DreamGourmetFinalChapter>[https://archive.is/5QV8y The final release of Kabigon's Dream Gourmet, being February 23rd, 2024.]</ref>

The story is about Kumura, a student at [[Uva Academy]] who prepares food for her Snorlax.
